patches.name: Proxy
patches.description: Routes all of the app's traffic through your HTTP or HTTPS proxy, with optional username and password. Nothing goes direct, even if the proxy is down.

options.title: Proxy host
options.description: Hostname or IP address of the proxy, for example proxy.example.com.

options.title: Proxy port
options.description: Port of the proxy, for example 443 for an HTTPS proxy or 8080 for a plain HTTP proxy.

options.title: HTTPS (TLS) proxy
options.description: On: the connection to the proxy itself is encrypted (an "HTTPS proxy", such as Caddy forward_proxy). Off: a plain HTTP proxy.

options.title: Username
options.description: Proxy username. Leave empty if the proxy has no login. Stored in plain text inside the patched app, so don't share the patched APK.

options.title: Password
options.description: Proxy password. Leave empty if the proxy has no login.
